global_layer.context: A single continuous take at an outdoor concrete skatepark on a sunny afternoon.
global_layer.description: A skateboarder rolls toward the camera, pops a kickflip, lands it cleanly and rolls away.

aesthetics.color_scheme: pale grey concrete, bright blue sky, a yellow T-shirt

audio_baseline.ambience: a skatepark: distant wheels rolling, wind, a few people cheering far away

objects_static.shape_and_color: black grip tape on top, red graphic on the bottom

lighting_baseline.direction: high and slightly behind the skater
lighting_baseline.shadows: short hard shadows directly under him
lighting_baseline.source_consistency: the lighting holds steady for the full clip

environment_baseline.background_setting: a concrete skatepark with ramps, rails and palm trees against a clear sky

visual_attributes.clothing: yellow T-shirt, black cargo pants, white sneakers, backward cap

camera_cinematography.default_depth_of_field: deep; skater and park both in focus

segment_basic_info.segment_description: He pushes twice, crouches and pops a kickflip; the board spins under him.

spatial_position.relative_size: full body fills half the frame height

action.motion_detail: back foot snaps the tail, front foot flicks off the edge, the board flips a full rotation in the air

causal_events.trigger: his front foot flicks the board
causal_events.effect_outcome: the board rotates one full turn under him
causal_events.physics: the board spins along its long axis then is caught by both feet

special_audio_events.sound_description: two pushes of urethane wheels rolling on concrete
a sharp wooden pop of the tail hitting concrete

segment_basic_info.segment_description: He lands with both feet on the bolts, rolls past the camera and raises a fist.
segment_basic_info.active_background: two friends cheer in the background

camera_delta.composition: full body, then passing to the right

action.body_configuration: knees bend on impact, then he stands tall
action.motion_detail: lands with a slight crouch, rolls past, lifts his right fist

special_audio_events.sound_description: a solid clack as all four wheels land
